subject: Exact borrowed-argument checking with fast WV component tests and current-source publisher reconstruction
claim: The isolated direct-call checker preserves borrowed kind and nominal identity, proves permitted Copy/shared read-through, and consumes arguments without repeated parameter scans or stack-prefix copying. Eighteen call groups plus eighteen owner-flow groups pass in 2,067 ms with cached products and fresh native execution. The current-source publisher reproducibility mode passes using the existing qualified segmented path. Complete WVB 1.39 admission remains closed.

limitations: These are isolated call-transfer and owner-flow components, not complete-module acceptance or runtime execution. Metadata admission, E1 operand-stack typing, borrow provenance, ordinary helper-loan lifetimes, safe return/field/value read-through, non-escape and runtime behavior remain unfinished. All complete consumers still reject WVB 1.39.

Call-shape tests assume an admitted type directory. Local aggregate traversal bounds do not charge repeated type-directory lookup across a module. Shared class evidence and a module-wide work budget are required before full admission. Callable read-through is conservatively unproved; the source compiler's general aggregate value-class classification also remains to be reconciled with the accepted Copy/shared rules.

The first baseline reports whole native-fixture execution, not an isolated H-call timer. Timings are single local observations, with retained bootstrap caches and possible concurrent work, not clean-host, cross-host, stable speedup or peak-memory claims.

GitHub run 33933126844 for the preceding commit failed on both development hosts because the publisher reconstruction expected an obsolete 511,544-byte current-source WVB. Removing that stale pin exposed the old monolithic lowerer's 4 MiB ceiling. The repair compares fresh current-source representations and reuses the already-qualified segmented path; immutable bootstrap/release pins and all 16 full-owner behaviors remain intact.

The full memory-budget owner declares 270 cases; its combined Foundation selector declares 99. Neither complete selection was run here. The final all-changed-file plan has 10 owners, 2,850 expected seconds and no coverage gaps; it was inspected, not executed under the ten-minute budget. No full publisher pass, Linux execution, WebAssembly, complete verifier/reconstruction suite, or cross-host qualification is claimed.

Current-source publisher selection only narrows that one already-selected owner for its exact source/project closure. It does not narrow other owners in a project-level plan, and script, publication-transaction, artifact or frozen-construction changes retain full routing.
These WV fixtures still use the bootstrap source edition. Migrating them and all other in-scope sources to edition 1 remains part of the active compiler/library migration goal.
